en: The image is a black-and-white photograph depicting a group of uniformed individuals, likely police or cadets, performing drills or training exercises on a field in front of a large building. The building has a clock tower and is of early 20th-century European architectural style. There is some vegetation in the foreground and background. The building is labeled as an administrative building of the Saxon State Police School in Meissen, Germany. The number '25037' is handwritten in red ink in the top right corner.
